projects.name: Signal
projects.scope: AI-powered security service provider platform for patrolling, dedicated shifts, guard operations, live tracking, incidents, billing, and analytics.

details.summary: Signal is designed to manage and optimize modern security operations through automation, real-time monitoring, and intelligent resource allocation.
details.architecture: The project is divided into focused modules so patrolling, dedicated shifts, guard operations, tracking, incidents, billing, reporting, and AI monitoring can scale with better performance, maintainability, and user experience.

modules.name: Authentication & User Management
modules.responsibility: Handles registration, login, role-based access, and account management for admins, clients, supervisors, and security guards.

modules.name: Guard Management Module
modules.responsibility: Manages guard profiles, availability, skills, certifications, and assignments.

modules.name: Dedicated Shift Management
modules.responsibility: Schedules and manages fixed security shifts for guards assigned to specific locations or clients.

modules.name: Patrolling Management Module
modules.responsibility: Tracks patrol routes, checkpoints, timings, and guard movement during patrol operations.

modules.name: Client Management Module
modules.responsibility: Maintains client records, security requirements, assigned guards, and service history.

modules.name: Attendance & Real-Time Tracking
modules.responsibility: Monitors guard attendance, check-ins, check-outs, GPS tracking, and live location updates.

modules.name: Incident Reporting System
modules.responsibility: Allows guards and supervisors to report incidents, emergencies, and suspicious activity with documentation.

modules.name: Communication & Notifications Module
modules.responsibility: Sends alerts, emergency messages, notifications, and shift reminders to relevant users.

modules.name: Billing & Payment Management
modules.responsibility: Handles invoices, service charges, payment tracking, and financial reporting.

modules.name: Reports & Analytics Dashboard
modules.responsibility: Provides performance reports, patrol summaries, attendance analytics, and security statistics.

modules.name: AI & Monitoring Features
modules.responsibility: Uses intelligent analysis to improve security efficiency, threat detection, and operational decision-making.
